research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: The work titled System for discharging a liquid component from a remote operated vehicle and its abstract describe a system for controlled release of liquid from a remote operated vehicle using an integrated valve system and valve body. This aligns with robots for labor intensive tasks by enabling robotic platforms to manage fluids for cleaning, spraying, or other liquid handling operations. Lucid Bots is researching and developing remote operated robotic systems for liquid discharge and fluid control in operational environments.

press_references.value: Lucid Bots Announces Lavo AI: The First Fully Autonomous Pressure Washing Robot

press_references.value: Lucid Bots Brings Embodied AI to Commercial Painting with Industry-First Robotic Capability

product_launches.description: Lucid Bots launched a painting and coating module for its Sherpa Drone, billed as the first commercial-scale robotic painting system, delivering up to 3x faster results at roughly half the cost. The module is available now and targets the $237B commercial painting market.

overview_description.description: Lucid Bots is a technology company that develops autonomous robotic systems designed for industrial cleaning and exterior maintenance tasks. It provides drones and robotic platforms used for applications such as building facade cleaning, window washing, and pressure washing in commercial environments. The company integrates software, sensors, and navigation systems to enable controlled and repeatable operations with reduced manual intervention. Its product offerings include hardware units, operator training, and support services for deployment and ongoing use. Lucid Bots also focuses on improving safety conditions by minimizing the need for workers to perform tasks at height or in hazardous environments.

about_short_description.short_description: Lucid Bots is a technology company that develops autonomous robotic systems designed for industrial cleaning and exterior maintenance tasks.

product.name: Sherpa Drone
product.description: An industrial aerial robot for exterior cleaning, spraying, coating, staining, waterproofing, and related work on buildings and other elevated surfaces.

product.name: Lavo Bot
product.description: An autonomous ground robot for commercial exterior surface cleaning that uses mapped routes and pressure-washing equipment to clean large areas with limited operator intervention.

product.name: Lucid Platform
product.description: The software platform used to operate, connect, monitor, and update Lucid Bots robots, including route planning, autonomous job execution, mapping, telemetry, and account management.

identifier.value: Robot Training, Deployment, and Support Services

product.name: Robot Training, Deployment, and Support Services
product.description: Operational services that help customers deploy and use Lucid Bots robots, including training, regulatory guidance, maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, parts, and customer support.

product.name: Lucid Suite
product.description: An optional robot protection plan that provides extended warranty coverage, selected maintenance support, discounts on parts and accessories, and loaner-robot benefits during the covered term.
